featured_reviews.name: shyam mange
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a very disappointing experience with Hanok Realty.

For the past 5 days, the broker kept assuring us that a final meeting with the property owner was scheduled for Saturday and asked us to stop exploring other options, saying the deal was almost confirmed. Based on this, we declined multiple other opportunities.

However, on the agreed day, there was no proper coordination, no clarity, and the commitments made were not honored. This caused us significant inconvenience and wasted our valuable time.

Additionally, from what I observed, multiple clients are taken to the same owner without proper scheduling or exclusivity. This creates unnecessary confusion for the owner as well and reflects a lack of professionalism. It also makes it seem like there is no real value or commitment given to any single client.

I would strongly advise others to be cautious and not rely solely on verbal assurances. Proper communication, transparency, and respect for clients’ time are extremely important in real estate dealings, which were clearly lacking here.
